title: Ridgeside Village spirit-realm terrain
author: Rafseazz and the Ridgeside Village contributors
modifications: Cropped native grass, path-edge, dirt and water-bank cells. Six earth colors converted from pale cream to warm gold; the three broad dirt tones use a compressed contrast range. Source pixel geometry and native resolution preserved. Append a second bank frame from the upstream map tile animation and two native flower-grass accents. No resampling. Grass interiors select fine-blade cells instead of repeating a complete four-by-four shadow-clump motif.
cropFormat: Original crop is [left, top, right, bottom], not [x, y, width, height].

animation.waterPlayback: Project adaptation (20260916T061625Z): low-contrast native strip current at alpha 0.28 over existing opaque native blue, with sparse intact 16x8 crest blocks placed at irregular vertical offsets. Crest mask removes background pixels with red channel <99, preserving native crest colors, alpha and geometry. 64px horizontal repeat drifts left 1 native pixel per 250ms; 64 frames/16 seconds. Bank pairs retain upstream 1000ms timing.

waterUnderlay.reason: Composite alpha-163 source highlights over water instead of lawn.
